en.brand.name: Square Hole
en.description: Part of the trading tax arrives here and is shared by the parts the creator chose before the sale.
en.errors.binding: This vault does not match the token. Nothing can be done here.
en.errors.insufficientFunds: Not enough tBNB for the network fee.
en.errors.read: Could not read the vault. Refresh to try again.
en.errors.reverted: The chain refused it; only network fees were spent.
en.errors.transaction: That did not go through. Check before trying again.
en.how.approval: Before a hand-in your wallet may ask for an approval first.
en.how.burn: Buy and burn buys the token from the pool and burns it. Each buy is at most 0.05% of the pool's coin side, with a minimum worked out from the pool's reserves at that moment.
en.how.lag: New tax arrives here when Flap's tax processor pays out, so this page can lag trading.
en.how.payee: A creator part goes to the address the creator chose before the sale. It can be a wallet or a contract, for example a staking pool or a card shop. A contract then follows its own rules.
en.how.payoutNative: What you redeem is paid in tBNB to the connected wallet. A contract wallet must be able to receive tBNB.
en.how.payoutToken: What you redeem is paid to the connected wallet.
en.how.share: One token's share is the pile divided by the circulating supply. That supply leaves out only burned tokens and tokens the pile holds.
en.how.sources: Any burn share and Flap's fee come off the tax before it arrives here. Any curve sale fees arrived here at the launch.
en.how.taxEnds: The tax stops when the token's tax period ends. Trades after that bring no new tax here.
en.how.upgrade: Flap's Guardian can upgrade this vault's code and the pile's code.
en.how.whole: Whoever hands in the whole circulating supply gets the whole pile.
en.notices.anyone: Anyone can share out. A part that cannot go out yet waits.
en.notices.burnPaced: Buys at most once a minute, a little each time; the rest waits.
en.notices.burned: The tokens you hand in are burned.
en.notices.review: Flap marks this contract unverified or higher risk. Check it before you act.
en.notices.riskMissing: Flap has not given this vault's risk status. Check it before you act.
